#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdlib>

using namespace std;

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(NULL);
    
    int n, B;
    cin >> n >> B;
    vector<int> a(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        cin >> a[i];
    }
    
    vector<int> costs;
    int cntEven = 0, cntOdd = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        if ((a[i] & 1) == 0) cntEven++;
        else cntOdd++;
        if (cntEven == cntOdd && i != n - 1) {
            int cost = abs(a[i] - a[i+1]);
            costs.push_back(cost);
        }
    }
    
    sort(costs.begin(), costs.end());
    int ans = 0;
    for (int cost : costs) {
        if (B < cost) break;
        B -= cost;
        ans++;
    }
    
    cout << ans << endl;
    return 0;
}
</translated_code>
